title: Awesome app, but!
body: I love the app, and the fact that most of it is free while other apps make you pay for the most basic things. But there are two downsides that i found. 1. there's a bug that skips activities that are not due that day in vacation mode (for example if i have gym friday but i don't have it on saturday for some reason it appears skipped on saturday). 2. there's really not a way to skip an activity and not lose %, even in vacation mode; if i go on vacation for say a week, I lose a lot of %.
author: Jusitn10407
